message: Recovery point for prd-db-01 is older than the RPO

rootCauseAnalysis.cause: The latest replicated recovery point of prd-db-01 is 45 minutes old and the policy gold-15m allows 15.
resolutions: Wait for the next replication of gold-15m to complete, then retry the test failover.
impacts: prd-db-01 would recover from stale data.

message: Network mapping for prod-vlan-110-db is missing on the recovery site

rootCauseAnalysis.cause: rp-database maps prod-vlan-100 to pc-ridge but names no target for prod-vlan-110-db.
resolutions: Add a network mapping for prod-vlan-110-db to the recovery plan rp-database.
impacts: The database NIC on prod-vlan-110-db would come up disconnected.
